lesson: Adaptive VT (VIX-regime dynamic vol target) uses same-month VIX to set VT level — this is circular because the VIX value at month-end is applied to decisions within that month. VT/DD overlays themselves are correctly lagged (t-1), but the VIX REGIME SIGNAL feeding the VT target is same-month (C11 violation). Additionally uses deprecated Soft MRS same-month pattern (L-441: ~18% SR overestimation). Defense sleeve FRED exposure lacks 1-month lag (contrast: indmom sleeve has shift(1)). All FF alpha t-stats <1.0 — no statistical alpha even before PIT correction. Concept of regime-adaptive VT is sound but requires previous-month VIX and Regime Engine v7.1.
